title.rendered: Salesforce Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire Braze

excerpt.rendered: SAN FRANCISCO & NEW YORK — Salesforce (NYSE: CRM), the world’s #1 AI CRM, today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Braze (NASDAQ: BRZE), a leading customer engagement platform, for approximately $5.66 billion in enterprise value.
